related.title: SOHO 太陽觀測衛星
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 Stokes 表、背景、未偏振對照及估值適用域。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver Stokes data,background,unpolarized control and estimator-validity domain.
related.difference: 從合成日冕影像估算平面投影速度，辨識三維幾何與到達時間推論限制。
related.differenceEn: Estimate plane-of-sky speed from synthetic coronagraph images and identify limits on 3D geometry and arrival inference.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先求 Q/U 向量長 50，再除 I，分開小數與百分比。
將半徑差換 km、分鐘換秒，求速度並畫距離時間線。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate Q/U vector length 50,then divide by I and distinguish fraction from percentage.
Convert radius difference to km and minutes to seconds,then plot distance against time.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: New Horizons 冥王星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 Stokes 表、背景、未偏振對照及估值適用域。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver Stokes data,background,unpolarized control and estimator-validity domain.
related.difference: 以直線飛越幾何估算目標距離門檻內的可觀測時間，安排互斥儀器任務。
related.differenceEn: Estimate time inside a target-distance limit using straight-line flyby geometry and schedule mutually exclusive instrument tasks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先求 Q/U 向量長 50，再除 I，分開小數與百分比。
由直角三角形求半弦長 8000 km，再乘二除速度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate Q/U vector length 50,then divide by I and distinguish fraction from percentage.
Use the right triangle to obtain half-chord 8000 km,then double and divide by speed.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
